author: elise.peeters@lumivia.be
title: Onboarding checklist (copy) - incl. non-EU hires
body:
Copied from the HR pages so everything is in one place for office admin.

New hire checklist
- Order laptop and badge
- Add to all@ mailing list
- Book welcome lunch
- For non-EU hires: the hiring manager sends the permit file to the Flemish department by email, takes about 4 months. Then the person gets a visa and registers at the town hall.
- Add to birthday calendar
